text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval from Etobicoke York Community Council to introduce overnight on-street permit parking on Sundel Avenue, between Cameron Avenue and Venn Crescent, on a street name basis, under the operating hours of 12:00 midnight to 6:00 a.m., 7 days a week. Residents requested the implementation of overnight on-street permit parking on Sundel Avenue to accommodate their long-term parking needs without being subject to tagging by Parking Enforcement Officers.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Approved the amendment of Schedule A of City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 925, Permit Parking, to incorporate the west side of Sundel Avenue, between Cameron Avenue, Venn Crescent, on a street name basis, under the operating hours of 12:00 midnight to 6:00 a.m., 7 days a week.
